audience: tour, rental and activity operators who take bookings with Checkfront

useCases.title: Check availability and rates for a date
useCases.text: Lists items with availability and rates for the dates and guest numbers you give, and shows which days of a month still have space.

useCases.title: List the bookings for a period
useCases.text: Lists bookings filtered by status, customer, dates or item, with code, totals and customer, and opens one for its line items and form fields.

useCases.title: Look up a customer and their bookings
useCases.text: Finds a customer by exact email, full name or phone number and reads the contact details and booking codes.

useCases.title: Create a booking for a customer
useCases.text: Reads the booking form, adds a rated item to a booking session and commits the booking with the customer's details.

useCases.title: Check in a guest or change a booking status
useCases.text: Marks a guest as arrived or departed, or sets a booking's status, for example to confirm a pending booking or cancel it.

useCases.title: Read booking notes or add one
useCases.text: Lists the notes left on bookings, by default from the past 30 days, and adds a note to a booking.
